title: Todd Combs: Meeting Munger, Buffett and Joining Berkshire
summary: Our hosts are joined by Amy Myers, Chief Marketing Officer at NFM, for an in-depth interview with Todd Combs. Todd is multi-billion-dollar investment manager with Berkshire Hathaway and is also the President and CEO of GEICO. Today, we're sitting down with Todd to talk about all the things that led him to Berkshire Hathaway.

key_points.text: Today, we're sitting down with Todd to talk about all the things that led him to Berkshire Hathaway.
From sitting in a lecture hall at Columbia University listening to Warren Buffet give a lecture to meeting Charlie Munger in the California Club to accepting the job at Berkshire Hathaway..
We're diving into the world of investing, achieving childhood dreams, and the importance of creating a home no matter where you go.
